title: X-LAB RS8 complete-bike specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the R7170 Di2 / BRANTA C45 UL complete bike, described as an all-round road bike (综合型公路车) using Toray T800 carbon frame technology. It states 7.4 kg without pedals in size M (paint finishes vary), an X-LAB RS8 carbon frame, carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes, Shimano 105 Di2 ST-R7170 with FD/RD-R7150, FC-R7100 50/34T, CS-R7101 11–34T, SM-BBR60 bottom bracket, BR-R7170 brakes with 160/140 mm rotors, BRANTA C45 UL wheels with 21 mm inner and 29 mm outer width and Center Lock rotor mounts, Maxxis HYPR ZK 700×28C clincher tires, a size-specific X-LAB carbon integrated bar from 380×80 to 420×120 mm, a 300 mm carbon seatpost, Selle Italia SLR Boost saddle, a 100 kg maximum load and five sizes with stack/reach XS 508/360, S 525/370, M 544/380, L 564/390, XL 587/400 mm. No maximum tire clearance is stated.
